overview: The Sloop is a traditional inn in Bantham village with a handful of en-suite rooms upstairs, several looking towards the coast. It sits a short walk from Bantham beach and the South West Coast Path, with a bar and restaurant downstairs serving locally sourced food. Children and dogs are welcome throughout.
surfTripFit: Walking distance to Bantham, one of South Devon's main surf beaches, with food and drink on site, and the inn points guests to a local surf school. Limited room numbers mean booking ahead in summer.
